data.name: Novalast
data.detailed_description:
It is the year 3125 - all out civil war has consumed the galaxy. Novalast, a nebula in the Zeta Quadrant is the last hope of achieving victory with it's vast quantities of Nolithium, used to power the great Nanite Forges.

Who will you side with, Captain?

Novalast - Fully physicalized space combat

Novalast is an immersive 2.5D Space RTS with a twist, you are in direct control of a ship on the frontlines - putting you in the Captain's chair, fighting on behalf of The Order of Terra or Sol's Vengeance, wrestling for control of the Novalast nebula.

Novalast features full physics based futuristic sci-fi combat, with strong emphasis on positioning. How you face the enemy will matter as your shields are in 4 quadrants, turrets have arcs with realistic tracking speeds, meaning you will have to adapt on the fly to ensure your strongest defenses are facing the enemy, and you can shoot them in their weakest points!

The Nolithium must flow

The game also features a fully physicalized logistics network system, where you extract Nolithium from mines / gas pockets as raw Nolithium, it makes it's way to your home base for refinement, then is distributed back out to the front lines. At any point, this supply chain can be disrupted.

Nolithium is the lifeblood of war. Without it, nothing can shoot, ships are crippled and defenses are easy pickings for the enemy. You must not only fight on the front, but also keep your supply lines flowing with Nolithium, or you will fall, as can the enemy if you disrupt their supply as well!
